messages:
nina: Proposal: use an epoched latch + quorum-read lateral takeover for canaries. Latch holds {variant, gen, epoch}, quorum-read across local replicas avoids single-node false-positives. TTL ~15s but adaptive.

paul: Quorum-read sounds heavier. How many replicas for quorum? 2-of-3? Also, if quorum fails we fallback to central adjudicator?

nina: Yes, 2-of-3 default. If quorum not achieved, sidecar must call central adjudicator. The idea is to reduce flips from noisy single-probe glitches.

jess: Important to emit takeover events and mark them in the rollout UI. Ops needs to know when lateral takeovers happened vs central-approved switches.

omar: Safety circuit idea: central service consumes takeover events and if takeover_rate > threshold, block new canaries for that tenant and surface an alert. That logic stays central.

paul: Storage: keep latch in-process with small ring buffer for event audit. Avoid networked caches for fast-path; replicate events to central for visibility only.

nina: Config POC (RFC will include): mode: hybrid, quorum: 2, base_ttl: 15s, min_ttl:2s, flip_hysteresis:3, cool_down:10s.

jess: Action items: nina to add RFC section, paul to prototype quorum read in sidecar, omar to draft event schema and UI flag. ops-bot: queued job rollout/latch-quorum-proto by paul, est 20m.

ops-bot: job queued - rollout/latch-quorum-proto (est 20m)
